I was raising this pet Pilehorn
Rhino Beetle I found at the
Abandoned Factory, but it died...

rows.label: tlk45100152_04_msg0002

So now I'm raising this
Tender Shark I caught at
the Nopon Pioneers' Secret Hot Spring!

rows.label: tlk45100152_04_msg0003

It's a kind one that looks after the
other fish. With seaweed around, it
doesn't need feeding.
